title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP10 — prepare CI authority destinations
goal: Temporarily exclude three absent stages/ci JSON destinations so the final CP10 change can add and schema-register them without relying on head-defined policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the three exact future CI JSON paths are added to the exclusion list; no CI authority or activation file is created.
The policy registry remains schema-valid and the trusted-base and weaken-policy obligations are authorized and consumed in separate local commits.
The final CP10 change removes every temporary exclusion while adding exact schema-bound registry entries.
